sentences.text: Jack Dorsey -LRB- born November 19 , 1976 -RRB- is an American computer programmer and internet entrepreneur widely known as a co-founder and CEO of Twitter , and as the founder and CEO of Square , a mobile payments company .	CEO	CEO	Twitter	Twitter	computer	computer	programmer	programmer	internet entrepreneur	internet entrepreneur	Square	Square, Inc.

For 2012 , The Wall Street Journal gave him the `` Innovator of the Year Award '' for technology .
